questions.q: The new software allows employees to access client files ------- from any location.
questions.why: access（動詞）を修飾するのは副詞。「安全に」アクセスできる。

questions.q: ------- the heavy rain, the outdoor concert took place as scheduled.
questions.why: 後ろが名詞句（the heavy rain）なので前置詞。「～にもかかわらず」。

questions.q: Mr. Okada, ------- designed the building, will speak at the opening ceremony.
questions.why: 先行詞は人で、あとに動詞 designed が続くので主格の関係代名詞。

questions.q: The sales figures for this quarter are significantly higher than ------- of last year.
questions.why: figures（複数形）の繰り返しを避ける代名詞は those。

questions.q: Not only ------- the report on time, but she also presented it to the board.
questions.why: Not only が文頭に出ると倒置が起こり、助動詞＋主語＋原形の語順になる。

questions.q: Of the three candidates, Ms. Reyes has the ------- experience in logistics.
questions.why: 3者以上の中で比べるので最上級。the のあとは most。

questions.q: The factory will remain closed ------- all safety inspections are completed.
questions.why: 「～するまで」という継続の期限を表す接続詞。during は前置詞で節を取れない。

questions.q: Please submit your expense report ------- the end of the month.
questions.why: 「～までに」という期限を表す前置詞は by。

questions.q: The seminar was so popular ------- additional sessions were added.
questions.why: so ～ that … の構文で「とても～なので…」。

questions.q: Ms. Kim was ------- by the board for her outstanding leadership.
questions.why: was のあとで「称賛された」という受け身。過去分詞を選ぶ。

questions.q: All applicants must have ------- completed the online form before the interview.
questions.why: 肯定文で「すでに」を表す副詞は already。yet は否定文・疑問文向き。

questions.q: The company is looking for a ------- accountant to join its finance department.
questions.why: 名詞 accountant を修飾する形容詞。「資格のある」会計士。

questions.q: Customers who purchase two or more items will receive a discount ------- their total bill.
questions.why: discount on ～ =「～の割引」。

questions.q: Mr. Evans asked the technician ------- the server immediately.
questions.why: ask 人 to 動詞 の形。「人に～するよう頼む」。

questions.q: Each of the new employees ------- required to attend the orientation.
questions.why: Each of ～ は単数扱い。現在の受け身なので is。

questions.q: The report ------- findings were published last week has drawn wide attention.
questions.why: 後ろに名詞 findings が続くので所有格の関係代名詞 whose。

questions.q: Employees may use the conference room ------- they reserve it in advance.
questions.why: 「～しさえすれば」という条件を表す接続詞表現。

questions.q: Ms. Sato is responsible for ------- new staff members.
questions.why: 前置詞 for のあとは名詞か動名詞。new staff members を目的語に取る動名詞。

questions.q: The CEO was pleased with the quarterly results, and ------- were the shareholders.
questions.why: 「～もそうだ」の肯定の so＋V＋S。主語と動詞が倒置される。

questions.q: The hotel offers ------- Wi-Fi to all registered guests.
questions.why: complimentary は「無料の」。宿泊客向けのサービスを表す。

questions.q: Due to a supplier delay, the launch of the product has been ------- until next spring.
questions.why: until next spring と合うのは「延期された」。

questions.q: Please ------- the attached invoice and confirm that the amounts are correct.
questions.why: 請求書を「見直す・確認する」。後半の confirm とも自然につながる。

questions.q: The updated safety regulations will go into ------- on January 1.
questions.why: go into effect =「施行される、発効する」。

questions.q: The airline apologized for the ------- caused by the cancelled flight.
questions.why: cause an inconvenience =「迷惑をかける」。お詫びの定番表現。

questions.q: The manager ------- all staff to submit their time sheets by Friday.
questions.why: remind 人 to 動詞 =「人に～することを念押しする」。

questions.q: The restaurant is famous for its wide ------- of vegetarian dishes.
questions.why: a wide selection of ～ =「幅広い品ぞろえの～」。

questions.q: The two companies plan to ------- their operations in order to reduce costs.
questions.why: consolidate =「統合する」。コスト削減の目的と合う。

questions.q: Travelers are advised to arrive early in ------- of the heavy traffic expected during the holiday.
questions.why: in anticipation of ～ =「～を見越して」。

questions.q: Employees must ------- with the safety regulations at all times.
questions.why: comply with ～ =「～に従う、準拠する」。
be 動詞のあとで受け身。be expected to ～ =「～する見込みである」。

free of charge =「無料で」。

docs.label: Article
docs.text: GREENFIELD (Nov. 5) — Orchard Valley Foods announced Thursday that it will build a second production facility in Greenfield, creating about 150 jobs over the next three years. The company, which makes frozen fruit desserts, currently operates a single plant in nearby Clarkton that has reached full capacity. "Demand has grown faster than we expected, particularly in export markets," said CEO Lena Hartmann. Construction is scheduled to begin in March and finish by the end of next year. The city council approved a ten-year tax reduction for the project last month, a decision that some residents criticized. Hartmann said the company will hold a job fair in January and will give priority to local applicants.

Northport Marina Hotel is seeking a Customer Experience Coordinator to join our front-of-house team.

Responsibilities: respond to guest feedback within 24 hours; organize weekly guest events; train new reception staff; prepare monthly satisfaction reports for the general manager.

We would like your talk, scheduled for Saturday, March 14, at 3:00 P.M., to focus on technology in language classrooms, the subject of your recent book. The forum will cover your round-trip airfare and two nights of hotel accommodation, and we offer an honorarium of $1,500. Please let me know whether you can accept by November 20 so that we can finalize the printed program. If you agree, I will send a speaker information packet, including technical requirements.

Sincerely,

Owen Hale
Program Chair

TRAVEL POLICY SUMMARY — Marlow Engineering

- All business trips must be approved by a department head at least ten days before departure.
- Flights: Economy class for trips under six hours. Business class is allowed on longer flights if approved by the Finance Department.
- Hotels: up to $140 per night in standard cities; up to $200 per night in cities on the high-cost list (Tokyo, London, New York).
- Meals: $50 per day. Receipts are required for all purchases over $15.
- Expense reports must be submitted within two weeks of returning. Late reports may be reimbursed only after the quarterly review.

NOTICE TO TENANTS — Elevator Modernization

Crestview Tower will modernize its three passenger elevators between November 16 and December 11. To keep the building accessible, only one elevator will be out of service at a time.

Elevator 1: November 16–24
Elevator 2: November 25–December 3
Elevator 3: December 4–11

Waiting times may be longer during the shutdowns, especially between 8:00 and 9:30 A.M. Tenants with mobility needs may contact the property office for assistance. Freight deliveries should use the service elevator at the rear, which will remain open. Questions: Property Office, 555-0172.
